text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Choco... Chocolate, huh. Valentine's 
chocolate for the Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Kita-chan. You're going to give them to 
him, right? Those delicious homemade 
chocolates.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Dia-chan... That was the plan, but I 
wonder if my homemade amateur chocolates 
will suit your taste?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Of course it goes well together! After 
all, Kita-chan's chocolate is...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Eeeh, what is this chocolate...? It's so 
delicious...!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Right, right? I worked super hard so I 
wouldn't lose to the ultra-fancy chocolate 
Dia-chan always gives me!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha... Exchanging them with Dia-chan 
every year definitely helped improve my 
skills.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Still, giving it to anyone other than 
Dia-chan feels kinda embarrassing.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Kita-chan—no. You have to properly thank 
the people who take care of you.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Kita-chan, you always say it, don't you? 
"Because my Trainer is here for me, I can 
run without any hesitation."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I believe seasonal events are meant for 
giving gifts packed full of all the 
heartfelt feelings you carry.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
The depth... of one's feelings... I see... 
you're right, aren't you...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"I'm super grateful to you, Trainer, so 
this is no time to be shy!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
All right, time to make the greatest 
chocolate of my whole life!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
The gym is all ours! Now we can make a 
giant chocolate to our heart's content!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
First, for the chocolate base at the 
bottom—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, the pitch-black earth... A mellow, 
creamy thickness coating the crunchy bite 
of frost columns."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: And what goes on top is...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Chocolate like white snow. Not just powder 
snow, though— a blizzard! And with a 
rough, dynamic touch to the decorations!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: —All done! This is my token of gratitude!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, Happy Valentine's Day! Please 
accept these feelings that are second to 
none!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I call it 'Northern Wasteland & Blizzard 
Chocolate'!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was truly the world of enka. Over the 
dark chocolate, a blizzard-like flurry of 
white chocolate danced wildly...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
It's not just the looks that are amazing! 
It's genuinely delicious, so please, don't 
hesitate to eat!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I don't know if this counts as showing my 
gratitude, but here, please! Please, go 
ahead!
choice_data_list: Thank you. But... isn't it too big?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
R-Right, exactly~. Things just kept 
escalating as I was making it...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, I'll deliver the rest 
straight to your room! Complete with home 
delivery service!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, having enjoyed Kitasan Black's 
delicious enka chocolate—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She had the rest carried to her room. With 
this, she probably won't be running out of 
chocolate anytime soon.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"With that in mind, I actually made 
another batch that's easier to eat."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I thought this one might be more 
affordable. Um... here you go!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Opening the package I received, there was 
a chocolate inside—crafted to look just 
like Kitasan Black.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it's kind of a joke, or like... I 
thought it'd be fun to make me out of dark 
chocolate.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
It's all thanks to you, Trainer, that I 
became such a fine Umamusume. So, here you 
go.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
It might not be flashy, but I'm confident 
in the depth of its flavor! Please, take 
your time and enjoy!
choice_data_list:
Thank you. What's the name of this 
chocolate?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
A name...? Well, seeing as yours is 
'Northern Wasteland & Blizzard 
Chocolate'...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After thinking for a while—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Alright, I've decided! This is—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
It's the 'Unforgettable, That Person 
Chocolate'!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
U-Um, you're right... Big things, heavy 
things. Maybe that's just the type I 
surprisingly am. Ahaha...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, the chocolate was delicious. Its 
honest, simple sweetness... spread deeply 
throughout my body."
